name: Meduketos
_notes: Transcribed from sheet EU3061 (Lv I-IX), trait cards EX3215-EX3217 + Fat with Light + Oxygen and Aether (EX3020), AI ER3062-ER3081, BP ES3082-ES3099, Storybook p.176-177 setup.
Microwave Attacks behave like Laser Attacks (Cycle III rules); while the Meduketos is outside the Board they originate from the closest Board Edge to the Target.
BP icons: ambrosia (BP I), microwave (BP II), both (BP III). "Disable Ambrosia Responses" disables the Responses of BP cards with the ambrosia icon.
Titan facing (Cycle V) is not tracked; Light X is emitted all around for Scan/targeting purposes.
Intermediary: chosen at the start of a Cycle V battle (+1 RAGE).

traits.Clicks & Pings: Meduketos starts the Battle outside of the Battle Board. When the Meduketos is outside of the Battle Board, it cannot be Targeted, unless from a VP. When the Meduketos attacks while outside of the Battle Board, it does so from the closest Board Edge to the Target, ignoring the initial ⚡ and any Move commands (in other words, the Meduketos stays outside of the Battle Board). Lightbend: The Meduketos disappears (remove the Primordial from the Battle Board). If able, place a Petrified Vent Terrain tile on the center of its previous space. Triggers when prompted.
traits.Hide & Heatseek: Once per Titan Round, Titans may perform a Scan (see Cycle V Storybook, p. 7): Choose a Titan and an adjacent Petrified Vent Terrain tile, then reveal the top Major Trauma card. This is called scanning a card. Instead of resolving the card, check the number in the lower left corner. If the total of every scanned card and the Light X value of the currently scanning Titan is equal to or higher than the Scan Difficulty, you have found the Meduketos! Immediately replace that Vent with the Meduketos (in any way), then perform ⚡ Skitter. If the total is lower, leave the Trauma card revealed and proceed to the next scanning Titan. Each Titan and each Vent may be chosen for a Scan only once per Round. End of the Titan Round: Shuffle all Major Trauma cards back into the deck. Scan Difficulty: Lvl 1: 9, 2: 10, 3: 11, 4: 12, 5: 13, 6: 14, 7: 15, 8: 16, 9: 18.
traits.Heat Death: Meduketos doesn't destroy Petrified Vent Terrain tiles it moves through. Meduketos's Crash causes incineration (death).
traits.Microwave Shield: Before performing an Attack Roll, for each space between you and the Meduketos, discard 1 token from the Kratos Pool.
traits.Slow Boiling: Each time the Meduketos gains a Wound (a Double Wound is treated as 2 Wounds), unless it was dealt from a VP, place a token on this Trait. After resolving the current action, if there are 3 or more tokens on this Trait, discard all tokens, then Lightbend and create 1 Vantage Point, then draw and resolve the top AI card.
traits.Fat with Light: For each dead Titan lower Scan Difficulty by 1.
traits.Truth or Death: Before performing a Scan, declare if the Meduketos is there. If you are not correct, after resolving the Scan, draw an Obol.
traits.Invisible Flame: When you climb the VP, gain 1 Ambrosia token and 1 Pain token. If you start your turn on the VP, gain 1 Ambrosia token and 1 Pain token.
traits.Nap of the Vent: Meduketos destroys Petrified Vent Terrain tiles it moves through.
traits.Tigerback: To leave the VP voluntarily, you need to pass a Climb Down test (same difficulty as the Climb test).
traits.Candle in the Dark: If your Light X is lower than the Primordial level divided by 2 (rounding up), Skitter loses ⚡.
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Black Soup: If you fail to find the Meduketos during the Titan Round, every Titan dies.
traits.Deeper Depths: Each Titan starts the Battle with 1 Oxygen token less.
traits.Original Trench: Normal (not Terrain) Battle Board spaces are considered Terrain tiles with the Chasm keyword. All other Terrain is considered Elevated.
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
traits.Oxygen and Aether: Each Titan starts the Battle with 2 Oxygen tokens. End of your turn: Flip 1 Oxygen token. If at any point you must flip or discard an Oxygen token and you don't have any, you die.

vp.name: Black Back
vp.text: Climb: Test Will (7+). Hold On — End of Primordial Round: If on a VP, test Endurance (9+). If Meduketos is outside the Board, test Courage (7+) instead. Fail: Discard 1 Oxygen token, Knockdown, displace to an adjacent space. If the Meduketos is outside the Battle Board, you die instead, and you cannot ignore or mitigate this Falling Down effect. VP effects: When on a VP, you gain +1 Power. End of your turn: Burn. You may take your turn even if the Primordial is outside of the Battle Board. Scan Test: For Scan Test purposes, you may choose any Petrified Vent Terrain tile on the Battle Board. Hard to See: If you are on a VP when the Primordial is outside of the Battle Board, you can be Targeted only if there are no other viable Targets.
